sources.title: Tiki Standard Product Return and Exchange Policy and Conditions
sources.excerpt:
Tiki Standard Product Return and Exchange Policy and Conditions
Customers may request an exchange or return within 30 days (for products directly distributed by Tiki Trading) or within 7 days (for products from marketplace partner sellers on Tiki) from the date of successful delivery. Returned products must have intact security seals, complete original packaging, accessories, invoices, and included promotional gifts, and show no signs of usage or laundering.
